verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story. For synthetic data, Isaac Sim generates labeled training data via Replicator and supports controllable synthetic data pipelines, including randomized warehouse scenes. For reinforcement learning at scale, Isaac Lab is a GPU-accelerated framework that supports RL with libraries such as skrl, RLLib and rl_games, runs headless from workstation to data center, and scales from a single GPU to a cluster. The community sim-to-real drift comment concerns deployment fidelity, not whether these capabilities exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale synthetic data generation and RL throughput.
